# @aponiajs/redis

> Redis client lifecycle and distributed store implementations for `@aponiajs/cache`, `@aponiajs/rate-limit`, `@aponiajs/session`, `@aponiajs/auth`, `@aponiajs/idempotency`, and `@aponiajs/cron`.

## What this package exports

- `RedisModule.forRoot(options)` and `RedisModule.forRootAsync(options)`
- `RedisService`: `client`, `ping()`, `cacheStore()`, `rateLimitStore()`, `sessionStore()`, `refreshTokenStore()`, `revocationStore()`, `idempotencyStore()`, `cronLockStore()`
- `RedisCacheStore`, `RedisRateLimitStore`, `RedisSessionStore`, `RedisRefreshTokenStore`, `RedisRevocationStore`, `RedisIdempotencyStore`, `RedisCronLockStore`
